brand_safety.note: Protection against competitor brand mentions. soft_redirect=prompt instruction; hard_block=more assertive; post_filter=redaction on final response.

brand_safety.level.label: Block level
brand_safety.level.help: "soft_redirect" steers the conversation away; "hard_block" refuses to answer; "post_filter" filters the already-generated reply.

compliance.note: EU AI Act risk classification (Annex III) and transparency evidence (Art. 50) for this deployment. Classification is metadata — it does not change bot behaviour.

compliance.annex_iv_doc_url.label: Annex IV documentation link
compliance.annex_iv_doc_url.help: Link to the technical document the system generates itself and keeps in blob storage.

compliance.annex_iv_generated_at.label: Documentation last generated
compliance.annex_iv_generated_at.help: Date and time in ISO format.

compliance.classification.label: Risk classification
compliance.classification.help: The EU AI Act risk classification for this deployment, following Annex III. It starts unclassified so that the outstanding work stays visible on the dashboard.

compliance.classification.annex_iii_answ.label: Annex III questionnaire answers
compliance.classification.annex_iii_answ.help: A map of {area: yes or no}. Kept for audit and to compare against future re-assessments.

compliance.classification.classified_at.label: Classified on
compliance.classification.classified_at.help: Date and time in ISO format.

compliance.classification.classified_by.label: Classified by
compliance.classification.classified_by.help: Name or email address of whoever made the classification.

compliance.classification.justification.label: Classification rationale
compliance.classification.justification.help: Text generated automatically from the answers and then editable by a person.

compliance.classification.next_review_du.label: Next review due
compliance.classification.next_review_du.help: The classification is re-assessed yearly and whenever the use of the system changes.

compliance.classification.reviewed_by_le.label: Signed off by legal
compliance.classification.reviewed_by_le.help: Optional: a missing legal sign-off does not block a limited-risk system.

compliance.classification.risk_level.label: Risk level
compliance.classification.risk_level.help: Set by the Annex III checklist. High risk switches on the extra obligations in the section below.

compliance.deployer_content_responsibili.label: Deployer responsibility for indexed content
compliance.deployer_content_responsibili.help: Article 50 transparency: responsibility for the indexed content sits with the deployer operating the system, formalised by a contractual clause.

compliance.high_risk.label: High-risk obligations
compliance.high_risk.help: Extra obligations from Articles 11, 12, 14 and 73, required only when the risk level is high. These are metadata: they do not change how the assistant behaves.

compliance.high_risk.enabled.label: Turn on high-risk obligations
compliance.high_risk.enabled.help: Required before going to production when the risk level is high, together with the fields below.

compliance.high_risk.human_oversight_con.label: Human oversight contact
compliance.high_risk.human_oversight_con.help: Article 14: the person designated to oversee the system.

compliance.high_risk.log_retention_days.label: Log retention (days)
compliance.high_risk.log_retention_days.help: Article 12: the legal minimum is six months, that is 180 days.

compliance.retention.label: Conversation retention (GDPR)
compliance.retention.help: How long conversations are kept in the database, in days. The assistant applies this to every conversation and message it stores. A conversation's clock restarts with each new turn; 0 means never expire.

compliance.retention.conversations_anony.label: Anonymous conversations (days)
compliance.retention.conversations_anony.help: Retention for visitors who are not signed in. Default 90 days; 0 keeps them forever.

compliance.retention.conversations_authe.label: Signed-in conversations (days)
compliance.retention.conversations_authe.help: Retention for signed-in users, who can also delete their own history. Default 0, that is no expiry.

compliance.high_risk.oversight_procedure.label: Oversight procedure link
compliance.high_risk.oversight_procedure.help: Link to the internal procedure describing how oversight is carried out.

compliance.high_risk.serious_incident_co.label: Serious incident contact
compliance.high_risk.serious_incident_co.help: Article 73: who reports serious incidents to the authorities.

compliance.sector.label: Sector
compliance.sector.help: The sector the assistant is used in (e.g. real estate, utilities). Feeds the Annex IV technical documentation.

compliance.use_case.label: Use case
compliance.use_case.help: What the assistant concretely does in this deployment (e.g. "public-site FAQ and lead capture"). Feeds the Annex IV technical documentation.

contacts.attribute_paths.label: Contact attributes
contacts.attribute_paths.help: Maps an attribute name to the path it is read from on the request.

contacts.enabled.label: Enable unified contacts
contacts.enabled.help: Recognises the same contact across channels (phone, email, WhatsApp, user ID) deterministically. Off by default and always isolated per client.

contacts.identity_fields.label: Identity fields
contacts.identity_fields.help: Each entry is a pair: the identifier type (kind) and the path it is read from (path).

custom_instructions.label: Custom instructions
custom_instructions.help: Free text added to the assistant's instructions: business policies, examples, redirects. It complements the structured sections rather than replacing them.
custom_instructions.note: Free text injected in the system prompt between <domain> and <conversation_rules>. Write here specific rules that don't fit the structured sections (business policies, examples, redirects).

domain.description.label: Domain description
domain.description.note: Free-text description of the client domain — used by the LLM to understand scope.

frontend.aiDisclosure.label: AI disclosure
frontend.aiDisclosure.help: Transparency required by Article 50(1) of the EU AI Act: the user must know they are communicating with an AI system. On by default.

frontend.aiDisclosure.enabled.label: Show the disclosure
frontend.aiDisclosure.enabled.help: Shows the notice that the person is talking to an AI. Required by the AI Act (Art. 50).

frontend.aiDisclosure.textI18n.label: Disclosure text (multilingual)
frontend.aiDisclosure.textI18n.help: A map of {language: text}. Takes precedence over the single text.

frontend.assistantGender.label: Assistant gender
frontend.assistantGender.help: The assistant’s grammatical gender — affects articles and agreement in the frontend’s fixed captions.

frontend.auth.label: Authentication
frontend.auth.help: Frontend authentication and identity. The MSAL and OIDC fields are written into the client’s app configuration; the issuers and widget identity are read from the profile by the backend.
frontend.auth.note: Per-client frontend authentication (1 build for all). Written to the SWA runtime-config.json at deploy and read by MSAL before bootstrap. Use "Auto-detect" to fill tenant and scopes from the backend; the Client ID (SPA registration) is manual.

frontend.auth.apiScopes.label: API scopes
frontend.auth.apiScopes.help: An MSAL (Microsoft) field, written into the app configuration.

frontend.auth.authority.label: OIDC authority
frontend.auth.authority.help: The identity provider’s URL (authority/issuer). An OIDC field, written into the app configuration.

frontend.auth.clientId.label: Application (client) ID
frontend.auth.clientId.help: Used by both MSAL and OIDC. Written into the app configuration.

frontend.auth.loginType.label: Login type
frontend.auth.loginType.help: An MSAL (Microsoft) field, written into the app configuration.

frontend.auth.mode.label: Authentication requirement
frontend.auth.mode.help: The assistant's OWN sign-in (Microsoft/OIDC): 'none' offers no sign-in, 'optional' offers it, 'required' demands it. Independent of widget identity: with 'Widget identity' enabled, the user is identified by the host site in ANY mode — invisibly in 'none' and 'optional'; in 'required' that identity counts as the credential.

frontend.auth.providers.label: Trusted issuers
frontend.auth.providers.help: The OIDC issuers the backend accepts when validating tokens; the issuer is the pinning key. Read from the profile by the backend — never sent to the frontend.

frontend.auth.providers.audience.label: Expected audience
frontend.auth.providers.audience.help: The expected `aud` value. Empty does not validate the audience.

frontend.auth.providers.issuer.label: Expected issuer
frontend.auth.providers.issuer.help: The expected `iss` value — this is the pinning key.

frontend.auth.providers.jwks_uri.label: JWKS URI
frontend.auth.providers.jwks_uri.help: Empty discovers it automatically from the issuer’s `.well-known`.

frontend.auth.providers.label.label: Label for the Console
frontend.auth.providers.label.help: A friendly label shown in the Console’s interface.

frontend.auth.providers.primary.label: Primary issuer
frontend.auth.providers.primary.help: The primary issuer produces plain user identifiers; the rest are namespaced by issuer. With none marked, the first in the list is the primary one.

frontend.auth.providers.required_scope.label: Required scope
frontend.auth.providers.required_scope.help: Empty requires no scope at all.

frontend.auth.providers.tenant_id.label: Expected tenant ID
frontend.auth.providers.tenant_id.help: The expected `tid` value (Microsoft). Empty does not validate.

frontend.auth.scope.label: OIDC scope
frontend.auth.scope.help: An OIDC field. Empty uses a safe default in the frontend.

frontend.auth.tenantId.label: Tenant ID
frontend.auth.tenantId.help: An MSAL (Microsoft) field, written into the app configuration.

frontend.auth.tenantMode.label: Tenant scope
frontend.auth.tenantMode.help: An MSAL (Microsoft) field, written into the app configuration.

frontend.auth.widget_identity.label: Widget identity
frontend.auth.widget_identity.help: Identity by signed token. The HMAC secret lives in the client’s Key Vault and the backend validates signature and age. Backend-only — never sent to the frontend.

frontend.auth.widget_identity.enabled.label: Enabled
frontend.auth.widget_identity.enabled.help: Accept the user identity signed by the backend of the site the widget is embedded in (Intercom/Zendesk pattern). Works with any 'Authentication requirement', including 'none' — it neither requires nor offers the assistant's own sign-in. Enable only after the secret exists in Key Vault.

frontend.auth.widget_identity.max_age_s.label: Token validity (s)
frontend.auth.widget_identity.max_age_s.help: The maximum accepted age for the token, as replay protection.

frontend.auth.widget_identity.secret_ref.label: Secret name
frontend.auth.widget_identity.secret_ref.help: The secret’s name in the client’s Key Vault.

frontend.branding.label: Branding and appearance
frontend.branding.note: Branding visible to the end user. Colours in hex #RRGGBB format.

frontend.branding.botAvatarShape.label: Avatar shape
frontend.branding.botAvatarShape.help: round = circle, soft = rounded corners, square = straight corners. Empty keeps the default.

frontend.branding.disclaimer.label: Footer disclaimer
frontend.branding.disclaimer.help: The frontend’s general footer. Not the AI disclosure, which is the mandatory legal notice.
frontend.branding.disclaimer.note: Small text in the chat footer (e.g. "MaintainAI may make mistakes…")

frontend.branding.disclaimerI18n.label: Footer disclaimer (multilingual)
frontend.branding.disclaimerI18n.help: A map of {language: text}. Takes precedence over the single-text footer.

frontend.branding.favicon.label: Favicon
frontend.branding.favicon.help: A URL in the `branding` container — uploaded via the Console.

frontend.branding.headerText.label: Text beside the logo
frontend.branding.headerText.help: Shown in the header, beside the logo (e.g. "Antonius"). Multilingual.

frontend.branding.headerTextColor.label: Header text colour
frontend.branding.headerTextColor.help: Optional — empty uses the theme’s default.

frontend.branding.headerTextSize.label: Header text size
frontend.branding.headerTextSize.help: Optional, e.g. "20px" or "1.25rem" — empty uses the theme’s default.

frontend.branding.logoDark.label: Logo (dark theme)
frontend.branding.logoDark.help: A URL in the `branding` container — uploaded via the Console.

frontend.branding.logoLight.label: Logo (light theme)
frontend.branding.logoLight.help: A URL in the `branding` container — uploaded via the Console.

frontend.branding.logoRail.label: Collapsed sidebar logo
frontend.branding.logoRail.help: A URL in the `branding` container — uploaded via the Console.
frontend.branding.logoRail.note: Image shown as the avatar in the assistant's replies. Empty → uses the name initial. (field: logoRail)

frontend.branding.primaryTextColor.label: Text colour on the primary colour

frontend.branding.theme.label: Colour theme
frontend.branding.theme.help: The full theme: the sidebar applies to both modes; the light and dark sub-themes cover the rest.
frontend.branding.theme.note: UI element colours. Sidebar colours apply to both modes (light/dark) by default; light/dark can override.

frontend.branding.theme.bgSidebar.label: Sidebar background
frontend.branding.theme.bgSidebar.help: Applies to both modes, light and dark.

frontend.branding.theme.bgSidebarSubtle.label: Subtle sidebar background
frontend.branding.theme.bgSidebarSubtle.help: Applies to both modes, light and dark.

frontend.branding.theme.dark.label: Dark mode
frontend.branding.theme.dark.help: The dark sub-theme. Colours in hex `#RRGGBB`.
frontend.branding.theme.dark.note: In dark mode you can also override bgSidebar/bgSidebarSubtle for a different sidebar

frontend.branding.theme.dark.bgSidebarCo.label: Collapsed sidebar background
frontend.branding.theme.dark.bgSidebarCo.help: A fine-grained component override — empty inherits from the matching semantic token.

frontend.branding.theme.dark.headerBg.label: Header background
frontend.branding.theme.dark.headerBg.help: A fine-grained component override — empty inherits from the matching semantic token.

frontend.branding.theme.dark.iconHeaderC.label: Header icon colour
frontend.branding.theme.dark.iconHeaderC.help: A fine-grained component override — empty inherits from the matching semantic token.

frontend.branding.theme.dark.iconInputCo.label: Input icon colour
frontend.branding.theme.dark.iconInputCo.help: A fine-grained component override — empty inherits from the matching semantic token.

frontend.branding.theme.dark.iconSidebar.label: Sidebar icon colour
frontend.branding.theme.dark.iconSidebar.help: A fine-grained component override — empty inherits from the matching semantic token.

frontend.branding.theme.dark.inputBg.label: Input background
frontend.branding.theme.dark.inputBg.help: A fine-grained component override — empty inherits from the matching semantic token.

frontend.branding.theme.dark.sourceCardB.label: Source card background
frontend.branding.theme.dark.sourceCardB.help: A fine-grained component override — empty inherits from the matching semantic token.

frontend.branding.theme.dark.sourcesBubb.label: Sources bubble background
frontend.branding.theme.dark.sourcesBubb.help: A fine-grained component override — empty inherits from the matching semantic token.

frontend.branding.theme.dark.traceBubble.label: Trace bubble background
frontend.branding.theme.dark.traceBubble.help: A fine-grained component override — empty inherits from the matching semantic token.

frontend.branding.theme.dark.welcomeCard.label: Welcome card background
frontend.branding.theme.dark.welcomeCard.help: A fine-grained component override — empty inherits from the matching semantic token.

frontend.branding.theme.light.label: Light mode
frontend.branding.theme.light.help: The light sub-theme. Colours in hex `#RRGGBB`.

frontend.branding.theme.light.bgSidebarC.label: Collapsed sidebar background
frontend.branding.theme.light.bgSidebarC.help: A fine-grained component override — empty inherits from the matching semantic token.

frontend.branding.theme.light.headerBg.label: Header background
frontend.branding.theme.light.headerBg.help: A fine-grained component override — empty inherits from the matching semantic token.

frontend.branding.theme.light.iconHeader.label: Header icon colour
frontend.branding.theme.light.iconHeader.help: A fine-grained component override — empty inherits from the matching semantic token.

frontend.branding.theme.light.iconInputC.label: Input icon colour
frontend.branding.theme.light.iconInputC.help: A fine-grained component override — empty inherits from the matching semantic token.

frontend.branding.theme.light.iconSideba.label: Sidebar icon colour
frontend.branding.theme.light.iconSideba.help: A fine-grained component override — empty inherits from the matching semantic token.

frontend.branding.theme.light.inputBg.label: Input background
frontend.branding.theme.light.inputBg.help: A fine-grained component override — empty inherits from the matching semantic token.

frontend.branding.theme.light.sourceCard.label: Source card background
frontend.branding.theme.light.sourceCard.help: A fine-grained component override — empty inherits from the matching semantic token.

frontend.branding.theme.light.sourcesBub.label: Sources bubble background
frontend.branding.theme.light.sourcesBub.help: A fine-grained component override — empty inherits from the matching semantic token.

frontend.branding.theme.light.traceBubbl.label: Trace bubble background
frontend.branding.theme.light.traceBubbl.help: A fine-grained component override — empty inherits from the matching semantic token.

frontend.branding.theme.light.welcomeCar.label: Welcome card background
frontend.branding.theme.light.welcomeCar.help: A fine-grained component override — empty inherits from the matching semantic token.

frontend.branding.theme.textSidebarPrima.label: Primary sidebar text
frontend.branding.theme.textSidebarPrima.help: Applies to both modes, light and dark.

frontend.branding.theme.textSidebarSecon.label: Secondary sidebar text
frontend.branding.theme.textSidebarSecon.help: Applies to both modes, light and dark.

frontend.branding.theme.textSidebarTerti.label: Tertiary sidebar text
frontend.branding.theme.textSidebarTerti.help: Applies to both modes, light and dark.

frontend.csp.extraConnectSrc.label: Extra connect origins (CSP)
frontend.csp.extraConnectSrc.note: Destinations allowed for fetch/XHR/WebSocket from the chat page. Applied at frontend rollout.

frontend.csp.extraFrameSrc.label: Extra frame origins (CSP)
frontend.csp.extraFrameSrc.note: Origins that may be embedded in the chat page. Applied at frontend rollout.

frontend.csp.extraScriptSrc.label: Extra script origins (CSP)
frontend.csp.extraScriptSrc.note: Security control. Adding an origin here authorises third-party scripts on the chat page. The Studio merges these lists into staticwebapp.config.json during the frontend rollout — no new rollout, no runtime effect.

frontend.features.label: Features
frontend.features.help: Frontend switches. Dependencies between features are declared in the schema, so the editor warns about and blocks incoherent combinations.
frontend.features.note: Toggles for visible features. You can add custom flags in the Blob JSON — any extra key is preserved.

frontend.features.enableDarkMode.label: Allow dark mode
frontend.features.enableDarkMode.help: Gives the user a switch for the dark theme.

frontend.features.enableDocumentUpload.label: Allow document upload
frontend.features.enableDocumentUpload.help: Lets people attach documents to the conversation.

frontend.features.enableInlineCitations.label: Inline citations
frontend.features.enableInlineCitations.help: Shows citation markers inline in the answer, linked to the source.

frontend.features.enablePdfExport.label: Export to PDF
frontend.features.enablePdfExport.help: Lets people save the conversation as a PDF.

frontend.features.enablePipelineTrace.label: Show answer diagnostics
frontend.features.enablePipelineTrace.help: When on, shows process transparency and an explainability summary.

frontend.features.enableShare.label: Share conversation
frontend.features.enableShare.help: Lets people generate a share link for the conversation. Its lifetime is set in the sharing section.

frontend.features.enableSourcePreview.label: Source preview (legacy)
frontend.features.enableSourcePreview.help: A legacy field kept in sync with "Source click action" — it exists for older frontend builds that read only this boolean.

frontend.features.enableStarterPrompts.label: Show starter prompts
frontend.features.enableStarterPrompts.help: Shows the starter suggestions on the opening screen.

frontend.features.enableTTS.label: Read answers aloud
frontend.features.enableTTS.help: Lets people hear the answer read aloud.

frontend.features.enableVoiceLoop.label: Continuous voice conversation
frontend.features.enableVoiceLoop.help: After answering, the microphone reopens on its own for the next question.

frontend.features.persistOriginals.label: Archive original files
frontend.features.persistOriginals.help: Keeps each upload’s original file (e.g. the invoice PDF) for audit. Auto-enabled when the extraction tools are present; this option forces the state.

frontend.features.renderSourcesSection.label: Keep the "Sources" section in the text
frontend.features.renderSourcesSection.help: By default that section is stripped from the answer. Enabled, it stays as the model wrote it.
frontend.features.renderSourcesSection.note: Mirrors retrieval.context_include_source_fields — the Studio editor keeps the two in sync.

frontend.features.reviewQueue.label: Human review queue
frontend.features.reviewQueue.help: Enables the review-queue route in the frontend. Also needs the `review_queue` container. Off by default — enabled only where contracted.

frontend.features.reviewQueueHome.label: Open on the review queue
frontend.features.reviewQueueHome.help: The queue becomes the landing page, without hiding the chat. Only takes effect with the review queue enabled.

frontend.features.reviewQueueOnly.label: Review queue only
frontend.features.reviewQueueOnly.help: Hides navigation back to the chat and redirects the chat to the queue — for operators who should only use the queue. Only meaningful with the queue on.

frontend.features.showHistory.label: Show history
frontend.features.showHistory.help: Shows previous conversations in the sidebar.

frontend.features.sourceClickAction.label: Source click action
frontend.features.sourceClickAction.help: "inline" opens an embedded preview panel; "newtab" opens the source in another tab; "none" shows the sources but makes them unclickable.

options.inline: Open a preview in the page

frontend.features.taskApi.label: Asynchronous requests
frontend.features.taskApi.help: Long requests return a task identifier instead, polled afterwards or delivered by webhook. Off by default.

frontend.features.toolWorkspace.label: Dedicated tool workspace
frontend.features.toolWorkspace.help: The tool opens a full visual instead of answering inside the chat. On by default.

frontend.features.turnOnVoiceRecorder.label: Voice recorder
frontend.features.turnOnVoiceRecorder.help: Shows the microphone so people can dictate instead of typing.

frontend.features.voiceMode.label: Voice conversation on the site
frontend.features.voiceMode.help: Shows or hides the voice button. The service itself is switched on server-side — without it the button does nothing.

frontend.insightsPanel.label: Insights panel
frontend.insightsPanel.help: The side panel. Visual types are read by the backend, which projects those visuals into the panel instead of inline in the conversation; the rest is consumed by the frontend.

frontend.insightsPanel.openOnLoad.label: Open on load
frontend.insightsPanel.openOnLoad.help: The panel is already open when the conversation loads.

frontend.insightsPanel.panelTypes.label: Visual types projected into the panel
frontend.insightsPanel.panelTypes.help: Read by the backend: visuals of these types are shown in the panel rather than in the conversation.

frontend.insightsPanel.providerBadge.label: Integration badge
frontend.insightsPanel.providerBadge.help: A pill in the panel header (e.g. "Xero · Connected"). It means the integration is configured in the profile — it is not a real-time health check.

frontend.insightsPanel.providerBadge.lab.label: Badge text
frontend.insightsPanel.providerBadge.lab.help: The text shown on the badge. Multilingual.

frontend.insightsPanel.quickInsights.label: Quick insights
frontend.insightsPanel.quickInsights.help: Fixed shortcuts in the panel, in two modes: with a prompt filled in it is a one-click shortcut; with a list of questions it becomes an expandable card.

frontend.insightsPanel.quickInsights.lab.label: Shortcut text
frontend.insightsPanel.quickInsights.lab.help: The text shown on the shortcut. Multilingual.

frontend.insightsPanel.quickInsights.pro.label: Prompt sent
frontend.insightsPanel.quickInsights.pro.help: When filled, the shortcut becomes a direct single click. When empty, it becomes an expandable card holding the questions below. Multilingual.

frontend.insightsPanel.quickInsights.que.label: Card questions
frontend.insightsPanel.quickInsights.que.help: The questions inside an expandable shortcut.

frontend.insightsPanel.quickInsights.que.label: Question text
frontend.insightsPanel.quickInsights.que.help: If the prompt below is left empty, this text is sent as the question instead.

frontend.insightsPanel.quickInsights.que.label: Prompt sent
frontend.insightsPanel.quickInsights.que.help: If empty, the question text is sent instead.

frontend.language.default.label: Frontend default language
frontend.language.default.help: The language the interface opens in before the visitor picks another.
frontend.language.default.note: CLOSED value space: the 8 languages in the fecore's UI_LANGS, as bare codes (pt, not pt-PT). A regional code degrades silently in pickLang.

frontend.language.enabled.label: Available languages
frontend.language.enabled.help: The languages the visitor can pick in the interface selector. Not to be confused with Allowed languages, which is the assistant's reply policy.
frontend.language.enabled.note: Reaches the chat selector UNFILTERED — a code outside UI_LANGS renders an entry whose strings fall back to English or Portuguese.

frontend.legalNotice.label: Legal notice (home screen)
frontend.legalNotice.help: A collapsible legal notice on the home screen. Markdown, multilingual ({language: text}).

frontend.llmModels.label: Available LLM models
frontend.llmModels.help: The model picker’s list — only relevant when the selector is on. Filled with the models actually deployed on the client’s OpenAI.

frontend.privacyPolicyI18n.label: Privacy policy (text)
frontend.privacyPolicyI18n.help: An alternative to the URL: multilingual markdown text shown inside the login modal itself.

frontend.privacyPolicyUrl.label: Privacy policy URL
frontend.privacyPolicyUrl.help: The client’s own GDPR policy, recommended — opens in another tab and replaces the login modal’s generic text. Takes precedence over the markdown text.

frontend.shareDefaultExpiryDays.label: Pre-selected lifetime (days)
frontend.shareDefaultExpiryDays.help: The value already chosen when someone shares a conversation.
frontend.shareDefaultExpiryDays.note: Pre-selected value in the share modal (days)

frontend.shareExpiryOptionsDays.label: Lifetime options (days)
frontend.shareExpiryOptionsDays.note: List of options in the dropdown (e.g. 7, 30, 90 days)

frontend.starterPrompts.label: Starter prompts
frontend.starterPrompts.help: Suggestions shown on the home screen. Title and prompt are multilingual maps supporting any number of languages.
frontend.starterPrompts.note: Suggested prompts on the start screen (typically 4). Bilingual PT/EN.

frontend.starterPrompts.iconName.label: Icon
frontend.starterPrompts.iconName.help: Chosen in the editor from the frontend’s icon set.
frontend.starterPrompts.iconName.note: lucide-react icon name (scroll-text, zap, history, cpu, …)

frontend.sttPhraseList.label: Phrase list (speech-to-text)
frontend.sttPhraseList.note: Terms the recognizer should favour (acronyms, jargon, brand names)

frontend.ttsPhoneticMap.label: Phonetic overrides (read aloud)
frontend.ttsPhoneticMap.note: Phonetic map for Text-to-Speech. Key = written form; value = pronunciation. Useful for brand names and acronyms.

frontend.welcomeMessage.label: Welcome title
frontend.welcomeMessage.help: The home screen’s title, shown before any conversation exists. Multilingual map ({language: text}).

frontend.welcomeMessageSize.label: Welcome title size
frontend.welcomeMessageSize.help: Font size for the title — for example "1.5rem".

frontend.welcomeMessageSizeMobile.label: Welcome title size on small screens
frontend.welcomeMessageSizeMobile.help: Empty inherits the normal welcome title size.

frontend.welcomeSubtitle.label: Welcome subtitle
frontend.welcomeSubtitle.help: An introductory subtitle below the title. Markdown, multilingual.

frontend.widget.label: Embeddable widget
frontend.widget.help: A widget embeddable in the client’s own site: the site pastes a single line of script and every other setting comes from here.

frontend.widget.allowed_origins.label: Sites allowed to embed
frontend.widget.allowed_origins.help: Empty allows any https site. With values, only the site itself and these origins may embed the widget.

frontend.widget.bubble_color.label: Bubble colour
frontend.widget.bubble_color.help: Empty uses the brand’s primary colour.

frontend.widget.bubble_icon_fit.label: Icon fit
frontend.widget.bubble_icon_fit.help: "contain" shows the whole icon; "cover" fills by cropping the edges; "full" makes the image the bubble itself. The bubble colour sits beneath for images with transparency.

options.full: The image is the bubble itself

frontend.widget.bubble_icon_scale_pct.label: Icon size (% of the diameter)
frontend.widget.bubble_icon_scale_pct.help: 54% is the historical proportion. Logos with a lot of padding need 70–90% so they aren’t drowned by the bubble colour.

frontend.widget.bubble_icon_url.label: Bubble icon
frontend.widget.bubble_icon_url.help: Empty uses the favicon or the collapsed-sidebar logo. Accepts an https URL or a data URI — the Console resizes the attached image before saving.

frontend.widget.bubble_label.label: Bubble label
frontend.widget.bubble_label.help: Optional text shown in a small pill beside the bubble. Multilingual.

frontend.widget.bubble_size_px.label: Bubble diameter (px)
frontend.widget.bubble_size_px.help: 56 is the historical value. The inner icon and the greeting balloon’s position both derive from it. The bounds are deliberately wide: some sites want a discreet bubble, others a prominent one.

frontend.widget.enabled.label: Widget enabled
frontend.widget.enabled.help: Turns on the chat bubble on the site where the snippet was pasted.

frontend.widget.greeting.label: Proactive greeting
frontend.widget.greeting.help: A greeting balloon shown without the user opening the widget. Empty turns it off, which is the default.

frontend.widget.greeting_delay_s.label: Greeting delay (s)
frontend.widget.greeting_delay_s.help: Seconds before the greeting bubble appears. Only applies if a greeting is written.

frontend.widget.mobile_mode.label: Behaviour on mobile
frontend.widget.mobile_mode.help: fullscreen = the panel takes the whole screen; sheet = a 95%-height sheet that leaves the site visible behind it.

frontend.widget.mode.label: Display mode
frontend.widget.mode.help: bubble = floating bubble in the corner; inline = the chat sits inside the page itself.

frontend.widget.offset_x_px.label: Horizontal offset (px)
frontend.widget.offset_x_px.help: Pixel-level adjustment, to avoid colliding with cookie banners and other fixed elements.

frontend.widget.offset_y_px.label: Vertical offset (px)
frontend.widget.offset_y_px.help: Pixel-level adjustment, to avoid colliding with cookie banners and other fixed elements.

frontend.widget.panel_height_px.label: Panel height (px)
frontend.widget.panel_height_px.help: Chat panel height on large screens.

frontend.widget.panel_width_px.label: Panel width (px)
frontend.widget.panel_width_px.help: Chat panel width on large screens.

frontend.widget.position.label: On-screen position
frontend.widget.position.help: Which corner of the screen the bubble sits in.

guardrails.note: Generic blocks. For active competitor brand protection use the Brand Safety tab.

guardrails.allow_general_knowledge.label: Allow general knowledge
guardrails.allow_general_knowledge.help: Allow answering from the model’s general knowledge when no relevant document source exists.
guardrails.allow_general_knowledge.note: (true = allow answering off-domain with general knowledge)

guardrails.citation_support_warning.label: Warn when a source doesn't support the claim
guardrails.citation_support_warning.help: The check always runs; this only decides whether the note is shown to the end user.
guardrails.citation_support_warning.note: False = shadow mode: detection still reaches traces, spans and dumps. The full kill-switch is the CITATION_SUPPORT_CHECK=0 env var.

guestAccess.dailyBudgetEur.label: Daily budget (euros)
guestAccess.dailyBudgetEur.help: Once it runs out, the demo variant is disabled automatically and comes back at midnight UTC. Zero means no budget.

guestAccess.enabled.label: Enable guest mode
guestAccess.enabled.help: Only takes effect on demo backends. On a real client backend the whole block stays inert, even if it is copied there by mistake.

guestAccess.rateLimits.label: Rate limits
guestAccess.rateLimits.help: Counted per visitor. Left blank, the backend default limits apply.

guestAccess.rateLimits.perDay.label: Requests per day
guestAccess.rateLimits.perDay.help: Questions a visitor may ask per day.

guestAccess.rateLimits.perHour.label: Requests per hour
guestAccess.rateLimits.perHour.help: Questions a visitor may ask per hour.

guestAccess.rateLimits.perMinute.label: Requests per minute
guestAccess.rateLimits.perMinute.help: Questions a visitor may ask per minute.

guestAccess.realtimeSessionEstEur.label: Estimated cost of one voice session (EUR)
guestAccess.realtimeSessionEstEur.note: Blocks a session from starting when the day's remaining budget won't cover it. Empty = DEMO_REALTIME_SESSION_EST_EUR env var, falling back to 0.50.

guestAccess.uploads.label: Guest file uploads
guestAccess.uploads.help: Off by default even when guest mode is on: anonymous public uploads are the biggest risk this feature carries.

guestAccess.uploads.maxFiles.label: Maximum number of files
guestAccess.uploads.maxFiles.help: Counted per conversation, not per request.

guestAccess.uploads.maxMb.label: Maximum size in megabytes
guestAccess.uploads.maxMb.help: Maximum size of each file a visitor attaches.

identity.note: Client and assistant identity. These values appear in headers, footers and generated prompts.

identity.assistant_role.label: Assistant role
identity.assistant_role.help: The role the assistant takes on when introducing itself and answering (e.g. "HR assistant"). Empty = no explicit role.

identity.default_language.label: Default language (unused)
identity.default_language.note: Deprecated (v0.1.51): nothing reads it. The answer language comes from the Language tab; the interface language from frontend.language.default.

identity.register.label: Register (form of address)
identity.register.help: "formal" or "informal" address, or "mirror" to match whatever register the user writes in.
identity.register.note: formal=formal address; informal=tu; mirror=mirror the user

identity.timezone.label: Time zone
identity.timezone.help: The business time zone, as an IANA name (e.g. Europe/Lisbon, Asia/Dubai). It sets what the assistant means by "today" and "now" — not each user’s own time zone.
identity.timezone.note: Profile > env TZ > Europe/Lisbon, resolved in core/agent/clock.py. An invalid name falls back with a log warning; it never breaks a turn.

ingest.alerts.label: Ingestion alerts
ingest.alerts.help: An aging and exception sweep at the end of every run of the ingestion job. Off by default.

ingest.alerts.aging_hours.label: Aging threshold before an alert (hours)
ingest.alerts.aging_hours.help: Never lower this value to save on costs.

ingest.alerts.email.label: Address the alerts are sent to

ingest.alerts.email_interval_hours.label: Hours between alert emails
ingest.alerts.email_interval_hours.help: Minimum gap between warnings, so the same email isn't repeated back to back.

ingest.alerts.enabled.label: Send alerts
ingest.alerts.enabled.help: Emails a warning when documents are stuck waiting to be processed.

ingest.sources.label: Email ingestion sources
ingest.sources.help: Each source describes a mailbox and how its messages are handled. The shape is free-form, so it is not validated field by field.

language.aliases.label: Language aliases
language.aliases.help: Maps one language code to another that stands in for it (e.g. treat pt-BR as pt-PT).
language.aliases.note: Silent normalizations in any strategy (e.g. pt-BR → pt-PT). Both keys AND values are LANGUAGE_CODES.

language.allowed.label: Allowed languages
language.allowed.help: The languages the assistant may reply in. Leave «*» for no limit, or list codes (pt-PT, en, es). Only takes effect under the «Detect, but only within the allowed list» strategy.
language.allowed.note: ["*"] = any; or codes from LANGUAGE_CODES in genesis_profile_schema.languages (only relevant for "restricted"). Open list: a code from outside is accepted.

language.fallback.label: Fallback language
language.fallback.help: The language the assistant answers in when it cannot follow the user's. Set by Genesis, because the value is an instruction to the model ("Portuguese (European Portuguese - pt-PT)") rather than a code like in Allowed languages.
language.fallback.note: ⚠️ The language NAME, not an ISO code — it goes to the model as an instruction. Pick from the list: a hand-typed "pt-PT" weakens it and leaves iso_code empty, with no error.

language.strategy.label: Language strategy
language.strategy.help: "auto_detect" follows the message’s language; "restricted" limits to the Allowed list; "frontend_locked" always follows the interface language.
language.strategy.note: Language policy. auto_detect=detect; restricted=detect but limited to list; frontend_locked=use frontend toggle.

options.restricted: Detect, but only within the allowed list
options.frontend_locked: Use the language chosen in the interface

mcp.note: Configured MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers. The agent discovers tools from these servers at runtime and uses them alongside native tools. Full editing (add/remove/test) in the Console MCP tab.

mcp.confirm_actions.label: Action confirmation
mcp.confirm_actions.help: When the assistant asks for confirmation before running an MCP tool. The default sits on the safe side.

mcp.disabledServers.label: Disabled servers
mcp.disabledServers.help: In a variant, switches off inherited base-profile servers by name. Lists replace one another rather than subtracting.

mcp.discovery_cache_ttl_seconds.label: Discovery cache lifetime (seconds)
mcp.discovery_cache_ttl_seconds.note: Discovery cache TTL (60-86400s). How long discovered tools stay in memory before re-discovery.

mcp.enabled.label: Enable MCP
mcp.enabled.note: Master switch — when off, no MCP server is queried regardless of the list

mcp.servers.label: MCP servers
mcp.servers.note: Configured server list — read-only view. To edit, open the full MCP editor.

mcp.servers.auth.label: Server authentication
mcp.servers.auth.help: Secrets are given as the name of an environment variable or key vault entry, never as the literal value.

mcp.servers.auth.client_id_env.label: Environment variable holding the client ID

mcp.servers.auth.client_secret.label: Client secret
mcp.servers.auth.client_secret.help: Prefer naming the environment variable over the literal value.

mcp.servers.auth.client_secret_env.label: Environment variable holding the client secret

mcp.servers.auth.per_user.label: Authenticate per user
mcp.servers.auth.per_user.help: When off, authentication happens once for the whole tenant.

mcp.servers.auth.token.label: Literal token
mcp.servers.auth.token.help: Development only. Use the environment variable instead.

mcp.servers.auth.token_env.label: Environment variable holding the token
mcp.servers.auth.token_env.help: The preferred way to supply the bearer token.

mcp.servers.erp.label: ERP role
mcp.servers.erp.help: Optional metadata declaring that this server acts as the ERP for a queue, for example naming the lookup tool. Free-form while it settles.

mcp.servers.tool_prefix.label: Tool prefix
mcp.servers.tool_prefix.help: If empty, the server name is used.

mcp.servers.trusted.label: Trusted server
mcp.servers.trusted.help: The MCP spec treats tool descriptions as untrusted. Only on a trusted server is each tool description passed to the model, after sanitising; otherwise a neutral description is used.

memory.enabled.label: Enable user memory
memory.enabled.help: The assistant remembers facts the user tells it and reuses them in later conversations.

memory.min_confidence.label: Minimum fact confidence
memory.min_confidence.help: Between 0 and 1. Facts the assistant inferred with confidence below this value are not used in answers.

memory.extraction_mode.label: When to learn new facts
memory.extraction_mode.help: "gated": only when the user talks about themselves (recommended). "always": on every message from signed-in users. "off": learns nothing new but keeps using what it already knows.

options.gated: Only when the user talks about themselves
options.always: On every message from signed-in users

memory.seed_from_identity.label: Use the sign-in name
memory.seed_from_identity.help: On the first signed-in session, stores the user's name and email domain to personalise greetings.

multiProfile.disabledSlugs.label: Disabled slugs
multiProfile.disabledSlugs.help: Switches a variant off without deleting its profile, so it can be switched back on later.

multiProfile.enabled.label: Enable multi-profile
multiProfile.enabled.help: When off, the link slug is ignored entirely and the base profile is always served.

multiProfile.invalidSlugBehavior.label: Invalid slug response
multiProfile.invalidSlugBehavior.help: An unknown or disabled slug returns an error and an explicit branded page. There is never a silent fall back to the base profile.

orchestration.agent_planner.label: Agent pre-planning
orchestration.agent_planner.help: A step before the loop classifies multi-step requests and injects a short plan into the prompt. Off by default; costs one internal model call whenever it fires.

orchestration.allow_web.label: Allow the web tool
orchestration.allow_web.help: When off, the web is never offered to the agent, whatever the retrieval strategy says.

orchestration.parallel_tools.label: Parallel tool execution
orchestration.parallel_tools.help: Runs independent calls in the same batch at the same time. Off by default; it cuts latency on multi-tool answers, but is worth validating per client.

personality.note: Communication tone and response style. tone_instructions is a dict (tone → text injected in the system prompt).

personality.response_length.label: Response length
personality.response_length.help: How developed the answers are by default.

personality.tone.label: Tone
personality.tone.help: The tone the assistant speaks in. The wording behind each tone is set by Genesis.

personality.tone_instructions.label: Tone instructions
personality.tone_instructions.help: The detailed instruction for each tone (professional, formal, friendly, technical, commercial) — the entry actually used is the one matching the Tone selected above.
personality.tone_instructions.note: Maps each `tone` to an instruction injected in the system prompt. You can add custom tones beyond the 5 defaults.

pricing.image_models.label: Image model prices
pricing.image_models.help: Model name to per-image prices, in dollars, by quality tier (low, medium, high).

pricing.models.label: Model prices
pricing.models.help: Model name to prices per million tokens, in dollars. Empty uses the backend built-in table.

pricing.usd_to_eur.label: USD→EUR rate
pricing.usd_to_eur.note: Used in cost calculations. Empty = env var, falling back to the backend default.

product_identification.note: Detection of alphanumeric codes in the query (SKUs, part numbers). Critical for B2B catalogues — embeddings are weak on codes.

product_identification.enabled.label: Enable product code detection
product_identification.enabled.help: Spots references, SKUs and model codes in the question and forces the agent to quote only what the knowledge base states literally about those codes.

product_identification.internal_prefixes.label: Internal reference prefixes
product_identification.internal_prefixes.note: Internal reference prefixes (e.g. OT, OBRA, FO)

product_identification.patterns.label: Code patterns
product_identification.patterns.help: Client-specific regular expressions. They are added to the built-in patterns rather than replacing them.

product_identification.strict_mode.label: Strict mode
product_identification.strict_mode.help: Tightens the instructions given to the model about the detected codes.
product_identification.strict_mode.note: (enables stricter block in the system prompt — forces literal citation)

query_cache.note: Exact-match query cache (hash of normalized query). Default OFF for B2B with unique queries — only enable for FAQ-style / demos.

query_cache.enabled.label: Enable answer caching
query_cache.enabled.help: Reuses answers to similar questions. Off by default, because it can serve a less well-tuned answer than one generated now.

query_cache.index_version.label: Cache index version
query_cache.index_version.help: The invalidation key. Raising the number invalidates the whole cache without deleting any documents.

response.note: Response behaviour — visible sources, images, follow-ups, extractive mode.

response.explainability_summary.label: Explainability summary
response.explainability_summary.help: Adds a 2-3 sentence summary of how the answer was produced (transparency, EU AI Act Art. 13).

response.extractive_mode.label: Extractive mode
response.extractive_mode.help: Answer by quoting the source text directly instead of paraphrasing it.
response.extractive_mode.note: forces the LLM to quote verbatim from chunks — ideal for compliance / procurement

response.followup_count.label: Follow-up suggestion count
response.followup_count.help: How many follow-up questions are suggested. 0 = none.

response.show_images.label: Show images
response.show_images.help: Lets answers include images taken from the documents.

response.show_sources.label: Show sources
response.show_sources.help: Shows the user which documents were consulted.

response.suggest_followups.label: Suggest follow-ups
response.suggest_followups.help: Show suggested related questions after each answer.

retrieval.context_include_source_fields.label: Include source fields in context
retrieval.context_include_source_fields.help: Prepends Source/Url/Page/Tier lines to each chunk’s context, before its content.

retrieval.context_top_k.label: Final context cut
retrieval.context_top_k.help: Number of already-ranked chunks that actually reach the model. 0 = no cut (all of Top K).

retrieval.faithfulness_overlap_skip.label: Overlap threshold (faithfulness)
retrieval.faithfulness_overlap_skip.help: Above this overlap with the source, the answer’s faithfulness check is skipped.

retrieval.force_diversity.label: Force diversity
retrieval.force_diversity.help: Prioritises chunks from different sources instead of letting one source dominate.

retrieval.fuzzy_correction.label: Fuzzy correction
retrieval.fuzzy_correction.help: Attempts to correct spelling mistakes in the question before searching.

retrieval.gpt_rerank_broad.label: Broad LLM rerank
retrieval.gpt_rerank_broad.help: A language model re-ranks candidates by relevance before the final cut (broad searches only). Extra cost per query.

retrieval.indexes.label: Per-index configuration
retrieval.indexes.help: Weight and rerank mode per index, for multi-index setups. Empty = every index treated equally.

retrieval.indexes.rerank_mode.label: Rerank mode
retrieval.indexes.rerank_mode.help: "llm" makes this index’s chunks eligible for LLM rerank; "semantic_only" uses only the semantic reranker.

retrieval.indexes.weight.label: Weight
retrieval.indexes.weight.help: Scales this index’s chunks’ rerank score when merging multiple indexes.

retrieval.latest_version.label: Latest-version routing
retrieval.latest_version.help: For questions about the most recent version of a document family, restricts context to that version.

retrieval.latest_version.strategy.label: Version strategy
retrieval.latest_version.strategy.help: "field" reads a date/version field from the index; "path" derives the year from the source’s own path.

retrieval.neighbor_expansion.label: Neighbor expansion
retrieval.neighbor_expansion.help: Pulls in the chunks adjacent to the best anchors, for answers that cross chunk boundaries (tables, clauses).

retrieval.refuse_pregen_min_score.label: Refusal threshold before generating
retrieval.refuse_pregen_min_score.note: Below this score the bot refuses rather than answering on weak grounding. 0 disables; the core clamps to [1.0, 3.0].

retrieval.rerank_top_k.label: GPT rerank chunk cap
retrieval.rerank_top_k.note: Only applies with forced diversity. Raise it together with top_k, or the rerank throttles the widened pool.

retrieval.search_index_names.label: Search indexes
retrieval.search_index_names.help: Azure AI Search indexes to query. Empty = use the fleet’s configuration.

retrieval.source_priority.label: Source priority
retrieval.source_priority.help: Orders context by the source’s authority tier (internal → legal → external) rather than score alone.

retrieval.source_priority.reranker_floor.label: Reranker floor
retrieval.source_priority.reranker_floor.help: Higher-tier sources scoring below this floor are deferred behind lower-tier sources that score above it.

retrieval.source_priority.strategy.label: Tier strategy
retrieval.source_priority.strategy.help: "field" reads a metadata field from the index; "path" derives the tier from the source’s own path.

retrieval.source_url_sas_ttl_days.label: Source link lifetime (days)
retrieval.source_url_sas_ttl_days.note: Once expired, asking again returns the current source and the frontend shows "source expired". 0 = unsigned, public containers only.

retrieval.top_k.label: Top K
retrieval.top_k.help: Number of chunks retrieved from the index before any further cut.

retrieval.topicality_gate.label: Topicality gate
retrieval.topicality_gate.help: Rejects off-topic chunks before they reach the model.

retrieval.weak_grounding_ceiling.label: Weak-grounding ceiling
retrieval.weak_grounding_ceiling.note: Between the refusal threshold and this ceiling, relevance is declared LOW and the model is barred from answering from its own knowledge. 0 disables.

reviewQueues.label: Review queues
reviewQueues.note: Map of queues by key. A queue referenced by a name absent here becomes a phantom queue in Cosmos.

runtime.agent_mode.label: Default reasoning effort
runtime.agent_mode.help: Applied when the request carries no mode chosen by the user. It does not cover the internal model, which always runs in the fast mode.

runtime.agent_model.label: Agent model
runtime.agent_model.help: Must name a deployment that exists in the OpenAI or Foundry resource. Left blank, the model already configured on the server is kept.

runtime.internal_model.label: Internal helper model
runtime.internal_model.help: The deployment of the smaller model used for internal tasks. Left blank, whatever the server has configured is kept.

runtime.summary_every_n_turns.label: Summarise the conversation every N turns

system_prompt_disclaimers.label: Approved standard phrases
system_prompt_disclaimers.help: Phrases the assistant may include even though they don't come from the documents. Listing them here stops them being flagged as invented.
system_prompt_disclaimers.note: Standard phrases the bot was instructed to optionally include via custom_instructions, but that do NOT come from RAG chunks. Listing here avoids hallucination flags from judges.

tool_limits.max_attached_doc_chars.label: Character limit per attached document
tool_limits.max_attached_doc_chars.help: Maximum amount of text read from an attached document, in characters.

tool_limits.max_user_prompt_chars.label: Character limit for a question
tool_limits.max_user_prompt_chars.help: Maximum size of a single question, in characters.

tools.note: Active agent tools. config is a dict per tool (passed to tool.__init__).

tools.config.label: Per-tool configuration
tools.config.help: An open structure: each tool defines its own fields, so a new tool needs no schema change.
tools.config.note: (open JSON — key = tool name, value = dict of parameters)

tools.config.extract_legal_terms.label: Legal term extraction
tools.config.extract_legal_terms.help: A document extraction engine with a per-profile schema. Each field comes back with its value and the page or clause reference where it was found.

tools.config.extract_legal_terms.prompt_.label: Client domain instructions
tools.config.extract_legal_terms.prompt_.help: Appended to the legal model’s base contract — they never replace it.

tools.config.extract_legal_terms.prompt_.label: Instruction preset
tools.config.extract_legal_terms.prompt_.help: A product preset from the tool_playbooks catalogue. Empty leaves only the base contract.

tools.config.extract_legal_terms.schema.label: Extraction schema
tools.config.extract_legal_terms.schema.help: Each entry is a field to extract, with a label and an instruction. Empty uses the tool’s default schema (contract terms).

tools.config.generate_boq.prompt_custom.label: Free-form client instructions
tools.config.generate_boq.prompt_custom.help: Appended to the model’s base contract — they never replace it.

tools.config.generate_boq.prompt_preset.label: Measurement standard
tools.config.generate_boq.prompt_preset.help: A preset from the tool_playbooks catalogue (for example pronic_pt, pomi_gcc, cesmm_civil, nrm2_building). Empty leaves only the base contract.

tools.config.generate_boq.rates.label: Rate table
tools.config.generate_boq.rates.help: The explicit source of costs: the engine never invents prices. Each rule fills in lines that arrive with no price.

tools.config.generate_boq.rates.match.label: Text to match in the description

tools.config.generate_boq.rates.unit.label: Unit of measurement
tools.config.generate_boq.rates.unit.help: If given, the rule applies only when the line’s unit matches as well.

tools.config.generate_boq.scale.label: Scale calibration
tools.config.generate_boq.scale.help: Plausibility limits for the PDF drawing reader. Rarely touched: the scale is normally confirmed by the title block or the dimension chain. Empty uses the defaults.

tools.config.generate_boq.scale.max_corr.label: Maximum divergence between dimensions and title block
tools.config.generate_boq.scale.max_corr.help: Above this ratio the title block is discarded and the dimensions win. Engine default: 2.5.

tools.config.generate_boq.scale.max_draw.label: Maximum plausible drawing span (mm)
tools.config.generate_boq.scale.max_draw.help: Engine default: 2,000,000 mm, that is 2 km. Raise it for civil works spanning several kilometres.

tools.config.generate_boq.scale.min_draw.label: Minimum plausible drawing span (mm)
tools.config.generate_boq.scale.min_draw.help: Engine default: 500 mm, that is 0.5 m. Lower it for details of small parts.

tools.config.generate_image.model.label: Image generation model
tools.config.generate_image.model.help: The deployment name, for example gpt-image-1. Empty uses the core’s default model.

tools.config.record_contact_details.label: Contact capture
tools.config.record_contact_details.help: Structured data collection during the conversation. The fields are fixed; the model only decides when to fill them. With no fields or no legal basis the tool stays inert.

tools.config.record_contact_details.capt.label: Record type
tools.config.record_contact_details.capt.help: Fixed per profile, never chosen by the model. It separates a sales lead from a job application or a quote request.

tools.config.record_contact_details.fiel.label: Fields to collect
tools.config.record_contact_details.fiel.help: The model sees exactly these fields and no others. Empty leaves the tool inert.

tools.config.record_contact_details.fiel.label: Fill-in instruction
tools.config.record_contact_details.fiel.help: Given to the model, not shown to the user.

tools.config.record_contact_details.fiel.label: Technical field key
tools.config.record_contact_details.fiel.help: English, snake_case. It is the parameter name the model sees and the key stored on the record.

tools.config.record_contact_details.fiel.label: Field label
tools.config.record_contact_details.fiel.help: Used in listings and in the privacy notice. Accepts plain text or a map of {language: text}.

tools.config.record_contact_details.fiel.label: Essential field
tools.config.record_contact_details.fiel.help: Does not block saving — a partial capture is still stored. It only feeds the record’s completeness score.

tools.config.record_contact_details.lega.label: Legal basis for processing
tools.config.record_contact_details.lega.help: The client’s decision as data controller. In an employment context consent is usually the wrong basis: the imbalance of power stops it being freely given.

options: Not set — the tool stays inactive

tools.config.record_contact_details.lega.label: When the legal basis was chosen
tools.config.record_contact_details.lega.help: Filled in automatically on save; it records when the decision was taken.

tools.config.record_contact_details.lega.label: Who chose the legal basis
tools.config.record_contact_details.lega.help: Filled in automatically on save; it records who took the decision.

tools.config.record_contact_details.noti.label: Notification recipients
tools.config.record_contact_details.noti.help: With the notification on, at least one address is required. These are not the ingest queue’s operational alerts, which have another owner.

tools.config.record_contact_details.noti.label: Notification email language
tools.config.record_contact_details.noti.help: This is the language of whoever reads the notice, not the visitor’s: an Arabic-speaking visitor produces a Portuguese email with the data in Arabic.

tools.config.record_contact_details.noti.label: Send an email notification
tools.config.record_contact_details.noti.help: Sent once per conversation, when the record becomes complete — not on every new field.

tools.config.record_contact_details.purp.label: Purpose of the collection
tools.config.record_contact_details.purp.help: Specific and in the client’s own voice — it is what appears in the consent request. Required when the legal basis is consent.

tools.config.record_contact_details.rete.label: Record retention (days)
tools.config.record_contact_details.rete.help: Counted from the last contact rather than from creation, because the record is updated as the conversation goes on. Empty or 0 means no expiry.

tools.config.search_web.temperature.label: Agent temperature
tools.config.search_web.temperature.help: Empty uses the agent’s own default temperature.

tools.enabled.label: Enabled tools
tools.enabled.help: The document RAG baseline. The backend’s live catalogue is the full list: the editor preselects these and shows the rest as toggles.

voice.aiDisclosure.label: AI notice at the start of the call
voice.aiDisclosure.help: Tells the caller they are speaking to an AI. Required by the AI Act (Art. 50).

voice.category_hints.label: Suggested categories
voice.category_hints.help: Categories offered to the assistant when it logs a request, so classification stays consistent.

voice.deployment.label: Voice model deployment
voice.deployment.help: The name of the Realtime deployment, for example gpt-realtime-2.1-mini.

voice.enabled.label: Enable the voice channel
voice.enabled.help: Off by default. The credentials for the channel live in Key Vault and never in the profile.

voice.queue.label: Ticket queue
voice.queue.help: Must match one of the queues defined under review queues.

voice.transcription.label: Call transcription
voice.transcription.help: A verbatim transcript, strictly opt-in: the client is the data controller. Off by default, leaving only the reconstructed summary.

voice.transcription.model.label: Transcription deployment
voice.transcription.model.help: The name of a transcription deployment. Do not use the gpt-4o family.

voice.transcription.retention_days.label: Transcript retention (days)
voice.transcription.retention_days.help: How many days transcripts are kept before deletion.

voice.web.enabled.label: Real-time voice on the site
voice.web.enabled.help: Switches on the server-side voice service. This is what makes the chat's voice button work.

voices.phonetic_map.label: Pronunciation corrections
voices.phonetic_map.help: Written word to the spelling the voice should read (for example API as “ay-pee-eye”). Added to the built-in substitutions.
